chapter: Bix, Trumbauer and the Goldkette sidemen
title: Eddie Lang the memorizer
summary: He describes guitarist Eddie Lang as someone who kept everything in his head and did not need to read, close to Joe Venuti.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Okay, thank you. What about the people on that record. Let me ask you. Eddie Lang was on that record.
What do you remember of Eddie Lang?
What about him? What kind of fellow was he?
A memorizer. How do you mean?
Well he would keep in his head everything that we did.
Uh huh. He didn't read music? Or he didn't have to?
He could but he didn't have to. So the people that we played for always wrote out the thing that we were supposed to play.
And that's what they came across.
He and Joe Venuti later, I guess it was later, became very close.
Was he close to him then, too?
Because after Goldkett, they went off together with Bing Crosby and they did some other things.
